title: Explore plan
description: The structured output of the explore workflow: one entry per issue in the batch. The apply job checks the whole plan, then does what it says.

issues.description: One entry per issue in the batch. Every issue exactly once.

number.description: The issue this entry is for.

duplicate_of.description: Only on a duplicate: the oldest issue in the batch it duplicates. That issue survives. Leave it out when this issue survives.

comment.description: The Markdown comment to post on the issue, as-is.
